label: common_0030_mama_02
text: Oh! Already in your uniform and everything![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0030_mama_03
text: Well, it is your first day at your new school,\nafter all.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0030_mama_05
text: Still, you might want to cool your engines before\nyou go racing out the door.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0030_mama_06
text: The school contacted me and said that you’re\nsupposed to wait here a little while longer.\r\nTheir words, not mine![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0030_mama_07
text: Apparently there’s something [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]very important[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] for\nyour first day that still hasn’t arrived.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0030_mama_08
text: Maybe that’s the very thing we’re waiting for!\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)], get the door, would you?[VAR 0x0114(002B)]
